== Description ==

[[Daniel Amor]] (front left, olive-green hoodie, glasses, grey sweats), [[Nathan Russell]] (back left, dark grey Mario 8-bit tee, glasses, balding), [[Logan Pietig]] (center, black UWL hoodie, blondish wavy hair, at the far end of the table), [[Anthony Howard]] (front right, black tee, forearm tattoo, beard, blue hoodie on chair), [[Benji Chu]] (background far left, navy Yankees tee + black cap & blue sleeve), [[Ken Cross]] (background center, black tee (back) & ponytail black/gold top), and [[Mark Billings]] (background center right, ponytail, black/gold chevron top) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
